package: not a package: marketplace connection HMAC delivery (apps/api infra/providers/marketplace/hook-auth.ts)
reason: A signed delivery has no timestamp, so a captured body can be posted again until the connection's secret is rotated. Adding a replay window needs the sender to send a timestamp, which the existing token and HMAC senders do not do, so a window would reject their deliveries. Duplicate leads are dropped by external id, which bounds the effect. Accepted instead of a breaking change.
exit: Add an optional signed timestamp header that is checked only when present, then require it for new connections. Decide again at the review date.
